summary: M6 Phase 1: Formalize profiling baselines and complete remaining audit items. Analysis already identified optimization targets (P1-P4). This plan captures remaining measurement tasks and produces the final audit artifacts.
approach: The analysis phase (ANL-007) already resolved TASK-1.4 (lazy-load audit) and TASK-1.5 (store subscription audit). This plan addresses: (1) running Lighthouse via chrome-devtools MCP for performance scores, (2) generating bundle visualizer report, (3) profiling React render cycles via chrome-devtools performance trace, (4) formalizing the optimization priority matrix. Tasks are ordered by dependency — Lighthouse needs a running dev server.

data_flow.diagram: TASK-001 (Lighthouse scores) + TASK-002 (render profiling) → TASK-003 (final audit report)

design_decisions: Lighthouse audit via chrome-devtools MCP — avoids manual browser interaction
Bundle visualizer deferred (requires vite-plugin installation) — baseline numbers already captured in analysis
React DevTools profiling via chrome-devtools performance trace instead of DevTools Profiler extension
